results.name: toolz-sliding-window
results.summary: Fixed the sliding_window function in toolz/itertoolz.py by changing the deque slice from i+1 to i. This ensures the first window starts at index 0. All tests pass.

results.name: tabulate-padding
results.summary: Fixed left-aligned column width in plain table format by correcting the _padright function to use width instead of width-1 for formatting. This ensures columns are wide enough to match separator lines. All tests pass.

results.name: humanize-naturalsize
results.summary: Fixed the naturalsize function to use base=1000 for decimal mode (when binary=False and gnu=False) and base=1024 for binary and gnu modes. This ensures that values like 3000000 bytes are correctly formatted as '3.0 MB' in decimal mode. All tests now pass.

results.name: jmespath-prefix-suffix
results.summary: Swapped the implementations of _func_ends_with and _func_starts_with in jmespath/functions.py. The ends_with function was incorrectly using str.startswith and starts_with was using str.endswith. After fixing, all compliance tests for functions pass.
